correctness.rationale: Exhaustive independent validity tests agree for all 65536 masks in each graph. All 4960 and 4224 directed face incidences are verified acyclic for explicit matchings. The Shrikhande matching leaves one vertex, one 2-cell, 58 3-cells, and a signed integral unit coefficient (+1 from mask 340 to mask 82), allowing cancellation and 57 free three-spheres. The rook matching leaves only one vertex and 105 3-cells. Two separately implemented boundary rank reductions confirm mod-two Betti rank 57 and 105. The proof checks the exact finite objects and does not infer infinite assertions from enumeration.

value.rationale: The canonical cospectral strongly regular (16,6,2,2) pair has a second-independence homotopy distinction by 57 vs 105 integral three-sphere summands. The problem is motivated by whether natural nonflag topology is controlled by graph regularity/common-neighbor data and refines previously known comparisons for different complexes. An explicit primitive attaching degree is necessary to settle integral homotopy beyond easily computed Euler or finite-field Betti data. This is a natural exact invariant, not an arbitrary slice or parameter substitution.
